lines.text: Jerusalem, once great among the nations, has become a widow, and her friends have betrayed her and become her enemies.
Judah has gone into exile and finds no place to rest, because the LORD brought her grief for her many transgressions.
The nations entered her sanctuary, and her people traded their treasures for bread to keep themselves alive.
The speaker's transgressions are bound into a yoke draped over the feet, and the Lord has trampled Judah like grapes in a winepress.
The LORD is righteous, the young men and maidens have gone into captivity, and the priests and elders perished in the city.
